text:
maria: Quick sync — building a 3-panel bench viz for launch: latency (p95), cost/token, and quality (eval score). Need final chart picks for webinar slide + blog hero. Thoughts? :sparkles:
aj: Love the 3-panel. Can we make latency panel an interactive histogram for demo? For slides, p95 line + shaded p50-p99 works.
samir: Agree. Important to call out per-request routing: hosted vs dedicated vs private. Maybe show same model on different deployment modes to highlight routing policy wins.
maria: Good call. We want a simple narrative: same output quality, tradeoffs in latency and cost depending on routing & quantization. Short headline: 'Same model. Tuned serving. Different economics.'
leah: For copy: 'Cut latency without breaking the bank' feels clickbait. Maybe: 'Reduce per-request cost up to X while preserving output quality' — need X from bench numbers.
benchbot: CI bench run complete — 3-panel data snapshot: latency p50=42ms p95=110ms; cost/token: 0.0009 hosted / 0.0005 dedicated / 0.00035 private; eval score delta <= 0.8%.
aj: Nice. Leah — use 0.8% as "within 1%". Keep claims conservative.
maria: For visuals: left: violin plot (latency), center: bar/stack cost by deployment, right: line showing eval score across quantization levels. Colors: teal/azure/charcoal. Anyone object?
samir: Use dotted fallback line showing degraded latency when capacity is limited — shows graceful degradation.
leah: CTA for webinar sign-up: 'see live demo + cost calculator' — make sure we have a small interactive calc in the demo.
maria: Action items:
- @aj: mock slides + export PNG by Tues
- @samir: run one more bench with high-concurrency burst scenario
- @leah: draft 2 headline options + 1-paragraph blog intro
- @benchbot: attach the CSV of latest bench
aj: Got it. I'll drop mocks in marketing drive and ping here :thumbsup:
benchbot: /artifact uploaded: https://bench-storage.redwood-ci/builds/1745556677/3panel_snapshot.csv
leah: I'll aim for - headline A: 'Tune serving, shrink cost' and B: 'Predictable latency, lower cost' — will avoid 'cut' language.
maria: Thanks all. If no objections, we'll lock visuals Friday and prep webinar invite. :calendar:
samir: No objections. One ask: include a small explainer callout on 'what triggers fallback' so customers understand routing.
maria: noted — add to slide 4. Closing now.
